embed.title: !disable (admin)
embed.description: Stop a user, channel or webhook getting alerts until an admin runs `{{prefix}}enable`.

fields.name: Usage
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}disable <id>` — by ID
{{#if isDiscord}}`{{prefix}}disable @user` — by mention
{{/if}}`{{prefix}}disable <id> <id>` — several at once
`{{prefix}}disable mywebhook` — a webhook, by name

Give bare IDs: `{{prefix}}disable user:<id>` doesn't work. IDs that aren't registered are listed in the reply.

fields.name: What it does
fields.value:
Their tracking, areas and profiles are kept, but they get no alerts and can't run commands other than `{{prefix}}poracle`.

If `[general] role_check_mode` is `"disable-user"`, a disabled user can switch themselves back on by running `{{prefix}}poracle` in a registration channel.

fields.name: Compared with
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}stop` — a user pausing their own alerts
`{{prefix}}unregister <id>` — delete a user and all their tracking
